$comment: Controlled vocabularies. Every tag used anywhere in the corpus must resolve here; tools/validate.mjs enforces it.

DE.name: Delaware
DE.annualReport: March 1 (corporations); LLC annual tax due June 1

CA.name: California
CA.annualReport: Statement of Information within 90 days of formation, then biennially (LLC) or annually (corporation)

TX.name: Texas
TX.annualReport: Public Information Report with the franchise tax report, due May 15

FL.name: Florida
FL.annualReport: Annual report due between January 1 and May 1

NY.name: New York
NY.annualReport: Biennial Statement due every two years in the anniversary month of formation

critical.meaning: Legally required, or its absence creates a defect that is expensive to cure later.

recommended.meaning: Market standard. Omitting it is a deliberate choice, not an oversight.

optional.meaning: Useful in some fact patterns; safe to omit.

insertion.auto: Inserted automatically whenever its conditions are satisfied.
insertion.suggest: Held back from the draft and surfaced by missing-clause detection so the user makes an explicit choice.
